The results of this study succeeded in developing a prototype application that has implemented the Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering algorithm which is used to visualize data processing so that it can help students determine high school majors. From the various experiments that have been carried out, this application has shown good resultsl.

Author Keywords: Major Determination in Senior High School

articleTitle: Image Enhancement Segmentation and Edge Detection in MRI for Mammogram Disease
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a medical imaging technique used in radiology to visualize internal structures in detail. MRI technology is excellent for identifying cancers, in identifying breast cancer, usually doctors or radiologists analyse images of magnetic resonance stored in Digital Imaging Communication in Medicine (DICOM) format. It takes expertise and experience enough for the diagnosis given precisely and accurately, so that handling can be done wisely. Image segmentation is intended to get the objects contained within the image and separate it from the background, while the edge detection is done to obtain the edges of the object. However, edge detection results are sometimes still not maximal therefore after edge detection is done to improve the image or commonly called image enhancement, to improve the image can be done in various ways tailored to the needs, in this study carried out by the High Pass Filter approach. Stages of the process consists of Gray scaling, Tresholding, Cropping, Edge Detection with Prewitt Operator, Image Enhancement then the image of the Enhancement result is done by Union Operation to fill the white pixel value which is in Edge Detection and then converted to binary value 0 and 1. This study used 4 test images consisting of 2 normal images and 2 abnormal images, 2 normal images in the mean as sampling. The test results with edge detection is not good enough so after edge detection is done enhancement to the image so as to produce the image with the appearance of the boundary line of each edge of the area is clearly visible and there is no disconnected edge.

articleTitle: Time and Cost Optimization Using Dynamic Programming and FMS Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Quality of information system at a company in Surabaya which is engaged in buying and selling wireless devices greatly affect the business performance of the company. One of the processes that support the running of this company is the process of Return Material Automatically (RMA). In this study, a RMA model business processes used by the authors for optimizing time and costs. To generate an alternative direction, the author uses an scheduling algorithm referred to Flexible Manufacturing System (FMS). After a time the optimal alternative route is obtained, it become input of programming objectives that will be calculated with Dynamic Programming, then the best route will be obtained using the optimal time and cost. The results of this study indicate that FMS Scheduling can be used to optimize time, and Dynamic Programming can be used to optimize the cost of this research. The results show that Trace 2 provides the optimal results compared to Trace 1.

articleTitle: Job Performance Analysis Using Factor Evaluation System and Process Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Job performance is a method to evaluate the performance such as a company or employee by comparing the work that has been finished in that several period with the standard of company. Factor Evaluation System method is one of popular method to used because it has 9 factors to analyze a position. But FES no more detail in spell out each factor, so in this research using process mining to enrich FES application. Process mining using event log that has history of case, activity, time stamp and resources of employee. This paper using AHP to get weight for every FES factor, so each factor have standard to be achieve. Considering the advantages of FES and process mining, this paper proposes the combination FES and process mining to more detailing the factors of FES, which are required for recruitment using factor all factor that have weight; employee monitoring using factor supervisory controls(2), guidelines(3) and personal contacts(6); for employee training using factor knowledge required by the position(1), personal contacts(6), purpose of contacts(7) and work environment(9); remuneration using factor complexity(4), scope and effect(5) and physical demands(8).

articleTitle: Mining Medication Behavior of the Completion Leprosy's Multi-Drug Therapy in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Leprosy is one of the listed neglected tropical diseases which is continuing as a major health problem in Indonesia. Low adherence to Multi-Drug Therapy (MDT) against leprosy is still a significant obstacle in disease control, as the defaulters with incomplete cure remain as potential sources of infection, lead to patients' irreversible complications and multidrug resistance. This paper aims to describe the behavior of leprosy patients during the long-term medication of MDT drugs through mining association rule between the on-time of taking MDT to healthcare facilities using apriori algorithm. Data has been collected from manual leprosy registry cohort of 27 Primary Health Care (PHC) at Pekalongan District start from June, 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> 2012 to June, 30<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> 2014. This study converted the range date between the MDT collection attendances to the new label, which is called on-time attendance (OTA), and on time completion (OTC). Both of MB and PB patients shows the association between MDT 2, MDT 3 have a strong relation to the late of the completion treatment behavior of leprosy patients.

articleTitle: Investigation of Ferroresonance Physical Behaviours on Three Phases Transformer with Unsymmetrical Core Leg
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Ferroresonance still become a confusing phenomenon since its non-linear response and very high sensitivity to parameter system and flux condition of transformer core. The existence of such greatly destructive phenomenon is basically caused by an interaction among different inductances (non-linear) with a capacitance. This paper investigated the physical characteristic of ferroresonance on three phases transformer with different dimension of core leg in which the greatest dimension was at the second phase (S-phase). A variation capacitance was given in order to observe the ferroresonance behaviours, that were 10 uF, 50 uF, and 100 uF. The transformer primary voltage and its total harmonics distortion (THD) were then analyzed. The results showed that the capacitance value was not linear with the ferroresonance effect level on transformer. The highest overvoltage level was seen on the test with a capacitance of 50 uF, namely about 180 %, whereas the greatest THD value was observed on the test with a capacitance of 10 uF, namely about 18 %. Moreover, the S-phase with the greatest core leg dimension was the most susceptible to ferroresonance as the highest overvoltage level and THD value was seen on this phase.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Some Video Players Based on Visual Output Quality
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Video is a media that is often used by humans for entertainment or learning. The video player application is used to play a video. In fact, many video player apps are in circulation today. Each of these applications has different qualities, both in terms of visual and in terms of audio. This study was conducted to determine the visual quality generated by frequently used video player applications such as KMP, GOM, MPC, and VLC. To measure the visual quality of the video can use the Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM). SSIM was chosen because it is more accurate, consistent and correlated with human visuals. The research stages begin with the process of video acquisition, video framing, capturing, and measurement. The results of this study show that KMP applications are able to provide better visual quality, where the application produces the highest overall SSIM average value of 0.99778. This result is an objective assessment that can be a recommendation for choosing a video player application.

articleTitle: Classification of Music Moods Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: In recent years, music has become part of everyone life. Almost everyone with different backgrounds listening to music, as a form of entertainment or just accompany in doing the activity. Music can be enjoyed in various ways based on the level of society. Usually music is categorized by genre, which shows the type of music or the form of music. Like pop, rock, metal, ballad, dangdut, jazz, keroncong, and etc. But the division by genre is common. So, in this study we try to classify a music into some moods like happy, peaceful, angry, and sad. Because such a classification will be easily accepted by listeners, especially people who are not very familiar with the genre. This classification is performed with 200 track databases for the training data and 50 track database for testing. We use a music features, such as pitch, pulse clarity, tempo, key, and scale. For the classification method in this paper we used Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), the accuracy that we have are 82%.

articleTitle: Design and Development of REST-Based Instagram Spam Detector for Indonesian Language
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Instagram, the most popular picture-based social media, has been well known for spam comments, mostly for public figures, including Indonesian actors and actress. Spam comments may lead to misleading information and confusing to other followers. Our previous research on Indonesian language spam comment detector has concluded that K-Nearest Neighbor yields the best result to detect Instagram spam comments. We continue previous our work by designing the REST -based web service to detect Indonesian language spam comments for Instagram. We are using supervised learning combined with Instagram dataset gathered from previous work. This system is built on top of Amazon Web Service (A WS) to provide a robust, resilience, and scalable system using Java Jersey library. The result of this work is a preliminary design and implementation of REST-based Instagram spam detector for Indonesian language that has an average response time of 1678.133 ms with deviation standard of 1178.59 ms. The current service still has limitations in terms of number of features and k-d tree data structure and it still needs some optimization before it can be used in production environment.

articleTitle: Automatic Gestational Age Estimation by Femur Length Using Integral Projection from Fetal Ultrasonography
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: The accuracy of scanning is important to properly know a fetus condition in the womb. However, the results still depend on a doctor's observation, so there are possibility of errors in identification. We propose an automatic gestational age identification system of images Using femur length parameters to reduce identification errors. The method used is a combination of Gaussian Filter, Morphology Operation, and Canny Edge Detection methods to improve scanning result and to minimalize the noise. Find Contour method is used to obtain the fetal femur object, then searched for femur length Using Integral Projection. This study uses samples of fetal femur data in second trimester. From the result of the study Integral Projection can be used to measure the femur length with an average success rate of 94.8% and the identification of gestational age with an average success rate of 97.6%.

articleTitle: RESTful Web Service Optimization with Compression and Encryption Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Along with the increasing number of mobile-based applications, the use of web services as a method of data exchange between systems also increased. With the web service technology, the exchange of data between systems with each other becomes easier even though it has a different platform. Increasing the amount of data requires more storage space on the server. Therefore, this research proposed the compression and encryption algorithm to optimize RESTful web service. We proposed LZW compression to reduce the storage space needed to store data on the server. We also proposed a Blowfish and AES-128 algorithm for securing data exchange through the internet network. The results show that all services made can run well and can be accessed through the Android application. In addition, the implementation of compression algorithm resulted in storage space savings of 38% with a compression rate of 1.78. The application of compression algorithm has an impact on the increase of computation time, although not significant.

articleTitle: Improvement of Fuzzy C-Mean Using Local Laplacian Filter for Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: The FCM (Fuzzy C-Mean) is on of algorithms used in the background image separation research. This study aims to improve the quality of image segmentation using FCM algorithm with Local Laplacian Filter. Thus, we applied the Local Laplacian Filter into the V (Value) and S (Saturation) component of the image. The result of Laplacian Filter then clustered using FCM method. The result of segmentation using FCM and Local Laplacian Filter will be compared with ground-truths images to reveal the value of the PSNR (Peak Signal to Noise Ratio) and the MSE (Mean Square Error). This study also compared the results of the MSE and PSNR with the FCM and K-Mean algorithms. The image is done preprocessing first by using Local Laplacian Filter which gives the color contrast to the image. So the image becomes sharper and when the image changed to the color space HSV already looks quite striking color differences between objects with the background. The results of this study indicate that segmentation using FCM and Local Laplacian Filter has the best MSE and PSNR results compared to the 2 tested algorithms.

articleTitle: Supplier Selection Using Combined Method of K-Means and Intuitionistic Fuzzy Topsis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Supplier selection as an important subject for survival of a business enterpris life. The selection of appropriate suppliers can be assisted by decision support methods. This research with title “Supplier Selection Using Combined Method of K-Means and Intuitionistic Fuzzy Topsis” purposed for help giving right supplier recomendation using decision making application using K-Means and Intuitionistic Fuzzy Topsis method at Citra Mart University Amikom Yogyakarta. In this research supplier decision making criteria are using price, delivery order, delivery speed, stock availibility, quality of service and purchase method. Research data is using 6 goods with 13 suppliers. This research is looking for the best supplier from many supplier of one goods with using combined Intuitionistic Fuzzy Topsis and K-Means for help clustering data with number value. In Fuzzy Topsis method is using eulidean distance algorithm for fixing Intuitionistic Fuzzy Set (IFS) number. Research is begin with diagnosing problem, system analysis, implementation to be application and evaluating result of method. Decision making evaluating using Mean Absolute Error (MAE). The result of this research has accuracy level of 0,64 from clustering, so this result can be concluded that succesfully to make a right price clustering and succesfully giving a right recomendation of supplier selection with using that method.

articleTitle: Interaction Design Consideration for Senior High School Students: A Usability Evaluation of Go-Jek Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Today Mobile applications have grown tremendously. Since it influences many aspects, therefore, the quality measurement of the mobile application is needed, and it requires a thorough system evaluation of the usefulness of the application. The purpose of this study is performed by a feasibility test which uses structured data analysis methods. Data collections are completed by distributing questionnaires to 53 students of SMA Negeri 1 Depok, Sleman, Yogyakarta, and the collected data were analyzed using Framework Analysis (FA) and Usability Problem Taxonomy (UPT) method. The analysis includes many processes i.e., arrange, classify, classify and severity measurement. The results of the study yielded 12 usability problems with the severity of 2.33 (medium). Go-Jek order view and Go-Life View have the highest severity with 4 (critical), Go-Jek Home View, Go-Pay View and Orders View with 3 (severe) severities, Help Menu View and Go-Jek View with severity 2 (severe). Most classification problems in UPT is related to Artifact Component. It can be categorized where main categories are Visualness (1), Language (7), and Manipulation (4.) Another component is Task Component which consist two main categories i.e. Task Mapping (5) and Task Facilitation (4). Our research shows that by using FA and UPT methods, the comprehensive evaluation can be performed.

articleTitle: Strategy for Optimizing Cost and Time of After Sales Using Integer Programming
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: After-sales service is a service that companies use to increase customer loyalty and trust in their products. in the handling, the company will implement two processes, namely replacement of goods or repairs. the decision to repair and replace certain items will cause problems. where the company will take optimal steps to choose to repair and replace. there are advantages and disadvantages in choosing one of these decisions. the repair process has the advantage that the cost of replacement of goods is minimal but has weaknesses in workmanship, while the replacement process has excess time but has a fairly expensive replacement cost. Continuous optimization is a way to produce results that will produce the best results that is appropriate. choices are based on variables used as decision supported. There are several methods that can be used to solve problems, one of which is Integer programming. Integer programming is a mathematical method used for optimization by maximizing or minimizing objective functions of constraints with decision variables in integers. Integer programming is chosen because it can produce replacement decisions or improvements with 0 or 1 notation. Integer programming supports decision making about replacement or repairment of returned products. The results show that the costs of the aftersales process is reduced by 12.14%, while the time is increased by 7.4%.

articleTitle: LoG Based Watermarking Over Region Magnitude Using Chinese Remainder Theorem
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: An embedding model is proposed to hide the watermark in region magnitudes of the image using the Laplacian of Gaussian filter that is developed from the two previous researches that using block based and edge based watermarking through CRT algorithms. The block based CRT can cause the significant degradation of image when it lies on the homogeneous area. Meanwhile, the preceding study of edge based CRT detector is generated the embedding location as same magnitude in binary representation. The watermark bits are embedding on any edges location. The edge based CRT is unable to determine the most significant area for the embedding. The proposed method embeds the watermark bits from the highest region magnitudes in descending order of number of watermark bits. This is aimed to improve the previous researches that used block and edge based CRT algorithms. The experiments show that this model has higher structural similarity than the block based CRT which has average similarity value of 0.9996 and 0.9985 respectively. It also improved the robustness against compression the higher average correlation value of 0.6709 than previous CRT scheme which results in 0.6681 and 0.6616. The proposed model has better image quality of watermarked image in term of SSIM measurement and increase the robustness of watermark image in term of compression.

articleTitle: Bit Localization in Least Significant Bit Using Fuzzy C-Means
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Least Significant Bit (LSB) as one of steganography methods that already exist today is really mainstream because easy to use, but has weakness that is too easy to decode the hidden message. It is because in LSB the message embedded evenly to all pixels of an image. This paper introduce a method of steganography that combine LSB with clustering method that is Fuzzy C-Means (FCM). It is abbreviated with LSB_FCM, then compare the stegano result with LSB method. Each image will divided into two cluster, then the biggest cluster capacity will be choosen, finally save the cluster coordinate key as place for embedded message. The key as a reference when decode the message. Each image has their own cluster capacity key. LSB_FCM has disadvantage that is limited place to embedded message, but it also has advantages compare with LSB that is LSB_FCM have more difficulty level when decrypted the message than LSB method, because in LSB_FCM the messages embedded randomly in the best cluster pixel of an image, so to decrypted people must have the cluster coordinate key of the image. Evaluation result show that the MSE and PSNR value of LSB_FCM some similiar with the pure LSB, it means that LSB_FCM can give imperceptible image as good as the pure LSB, but have better security from the embedding place.

articleTitle: Time and Cost Optimization of Business Process Distribution Company Using Goal Programming
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Often when a company is growing and just starting out the management team tend to make all the internal decisions, As the company reaches a certain size Standard operational procedure (SOP) is the important aspect to help the company to evaluate more than what they do now but also help the company to decide how to move forward. Having a standard operating procedure in place streamlines the process and management can accomplish more in optimizing time and cost, on business process of Return Material Authorization (RMA) which may not time and cost effective for the company which was about 2880 minutes with cost IDR. 348,242. In this research, the authors use Goal Programming to optimize time and cost. This approach improves the business process using analysis of multi objective problems. The results show that the time is reduced about 40% and the cost is reduced about 37%, which show improvement in the performance of the business process.

articleTitle: Digital Literacy Skills of Informatics Engineering Education Students as the Basis for Online Learning Implementation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Learning in the century of knowledge means that each individual can learn anywhere, anytime, with anyone, and through any media. The existing of technological developments are also ready to support the implementation of these online learning in desktop, web and mobile. With optimal utilization of ICT, it is hoped that learning can take place more attractive, real, and fun. The next problem that needs to be prepared is the assurance of digital literacy skills learners as the basis of the online learning application. Therefore, this research will be studied to the digital literacy skills of informatics engineering education students at Universitas Negeri Malang which are focused on the ability of information literacy, media literacy, and computer literacy. The research method is descriptive analysis with 99 respondents. The results of this study shows that the level of information literacy and media literacy students are in good category with the average value of 74,25% and 72,75%, while tech literacy ability is in very good category with the average value 83,75%. Based on these results it can be concluded that IT students have good literacy skills and can be improved through online and web-based learning.

articleTitle: Prediction of Glucose Content and Level of Tomato Maturity with Backpropagation Based on Image Vector Feature
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Predicting of tomato maturity is a major factor in tomato quality. It also affects the glucose content which is a side factor. The higher the maturity level is the higher the glucose content. Predicting of tomato maturity is still done based on direct visual vision. However, the disadvantage is the subjective nature of the sorting operator that is inconsistent in the classification process. With image processing approach, it can be predicted glucose content and level of maturity tomato. This study aims to predict glucose content and maturity level of tomato with backpropagation based on image vector feature of tomato. The sample image used is the image of tomato skin. Through it is determined by using red histogram, RGB, and HSV. Determination of tomato maturity level uses backpropagation with red histogram parameter. Meanwhile, the prediction of glucose content is done by using linear regression approach with RGB and HSV color models. The results showed that the determination of tomato maturity level with backpropagation obtained an accuracy of 86.67% with 4 hidden layer neurons and MSE = 0.01. The determination of glucose content has an error value of 7.57% calculated from the regression equation that is \pmbY=3.8205+ 0. 00598(|R-G|)+0. 715703 ( [(|R-G|)/(R+B)]).

articleTitle: Implementation of Weighted Naive Bayes Algorithm for Major Determination in Indonesian High School
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Major selection for 9<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> grade students aim to focus the student on building the skill and passion that they owned. It is also aimed to build the students' potential, passion and talent. By selecting the major that students passionate about, it is expected that they can improve the score of academic students. The process of major selection today has many drawbacks. One of them is that the process only considering the preference of students without looking at the students' academic background. This resulted in possible problem for students in the future, for example the students will not be able to pass the grades. In addition, the major selection will also affect the possible course when the students decide to continue their study to university level. This study proposed major selection by applying the techniques of classification in data mining. Weighted Naive Bayes Algorithm is implemented to determine high school major of students in junior high school of 33 Semarang. Experimental result shows 80% in accuracy. The system prototyping is developed for the visualization that can help student to determine major in senior high school.

articleTitle: Comparison of Severity on Mobile Government Application Mobile
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: At present E-Government in every country has been growing and experiencing stable growth, it is seen from many E-Governments which have started to provide services and information through an application especially with a mobile application. Through this development, we can get the benefit from user engagement in using a good E-Government app, usability, and credibility believed to be one of the factors affecting the developmental and growing participation. This research presents an empirical study in evaluating the usability of mobile E-Government mobile applications between two countries, namely BMKG INFO and MET Service Singapore. This study was conducted to determine the severity of the two applications. The results obtained show that by knowing the severity of the application, can be used for improvement on them.

articleTitle: The Using of Object-Oriented Method to Developing Android Application for Mapping Distribution of MSMEs (Micro, Small Medium Enterprises)
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: The objective of this research is to develop a Mobile Geographic Information System based on android mobile from user and customer requirements, which it will help the business owner in marketing their products. MSMEs has a big contribution not only to economic growth but also become a private income source for most of the people in Indonesia. Therefore, to increase the independence, efficiency and effectivity of MSMEs, utilization of information technology should be improved. The reason why a mobile application was chosen because mobile technology is one of technology that often used by the community. So, it's easy to use. An object-oriented approach was chosen in this system development because it can give a clear and understandable information to the stakeholders and also it can describe the task and function of each actor in the system. We expect that this model will help the developer to see the system and application comprehensively. And also help the owner of MSMEs to increase their effectiveness and efficiency in promoting their product.

articleTitle: Measuring Maturity Index of Risk Management for IT-Governance Using Fuzzy Ahp and Fuzzy Topsis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Increased business competition among the companies demand them to develop more. The development is not separated from the business risk and weaknesses. The business risks and weaknesses can be known and evaluated quickly using SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) which is simulated through YAWL application. Once the simulated weaknesses are identified, then it is conducted the index maturity of risk management to determine the company's understanding and concern on the existence of risks in the company's business process and risk management responsibilities within the organization itself. The method of measuring the evaluation of maturity index on risk management mostly uses measurement step by assessing and weighing the result from observation, interview, survey, etc., but if the data is not quite good then it will cause problem. Therefore, we need a new model for measuring and knowing the risk alternatives faster to be able to initiate risk-prevention. In this research, fuzzy logic model is used in making decision of the biggest risk alternative and to be handled for the first time. Fuzzy AHP will be used to calculate the value of the criteria, taken from the maturity index COBIT and Fuzzy TOPSIS to determine the selected alternative rating. It is observed that Managed and Measurable maturity index have the smallest weight of 0.0355 compared to other criteria (That means the company does not reach the level of maturity to understand risks in managed and measure) and Database Server achieves very serious attention because the score is very high compared to the other alternatives of 1.1186.

articleTitle: Searching Word Definitions in WordNet Based on ANEW Emotion Labels
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Emotion detection is the process of extracting emotion from human expression. Emotions may be expressed by facial expression, speech and even written text. The Affective Norms for English Words (ANEW) is a corpus that has been used in researches involving emotion detection. ANEW provides the score of valence, arousal, and dominance for each word. However, no information about the word definition is provided in ANEW. The goal of this research is to identify the correct definition of every word in ANEW as additional informations to improve its accuracy.

articleTitle: Surveillance Embedded IP Camera with Integrated Cloud Storage and Image Deblurring Using Richardson-Lucy
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: IP camera has been widely used to monitor an area for security purpose. Generally, this monitoring is done to supervise certain area which requires high privilege, so the IP camera can record all events which are occurred. Recording can be used to track what happened as if there was a law violation in the supervised area. However, when image data is retrieved, sometimes can occur damage due to a monitored object is moving. The image which has been damaged by the movement of this object is termed blur. Thus, to fix it is required image processing method such as deblurring. An image data also needs to be saved in the storage. By using cloud storage, it is going to get a large storage space and can also eliminate additional cost such as the maintenance of server storage. In this study is designed and is implemented the prototype of Surveillance Embedded IP Camera which has image processing feature (deblurring) using Richardson-Lucy method and the integration of storage using the cloud.

articleTitle: Outpatient Registration System Based on Android at BBKPM Surakarta
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: The development of information and communication technology increases rapidly, including the development of mobile phone technology that brings smartphone with various functions, one of them is as a source of information. It can encourage the public to access information and interact quickly. Along with these developments, BBKPM Surakarta has implemented a Short Message Service based registration system, but the system still has problems, such as Short Message Service replies received by patients is not appropriate. The strategy undertaken in accelerating the service is the outpatient registration system based on the android at BBKPM Surakarta. The purpose of this research is to make an outpatient registration system based on android at BBKM Surakarta. Type of the research uses descriptive, identification of variables used are patient data, physician data, polyclinic data, and payment data. The subject in this research is the registration officer, and the object in this research is part of registration and IT. Instruments used in this study are observation and interview, as well as used System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) system development method. The outpatient registration system based on Android at BBKPM Surakarta, was built to accelerate the process of service, especially in the registration section, with this application is expected that later patients can register anytime and anywhere, and can see the doctor's schedule before applying through an existing application on Android. Hospital information system at BBKPM Surakarta should be developed better, so that health service given to society will be more efficient to process of health service at the hospital.

articleTitle: Action Training and Assessment System with Kinect
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: To capture the action of the user in the action training and assessment system that will be developed, this work use Kinect as a means of data retrieval. The system is set to capture simple action and complicated action for comparison. The first action is a parameter used in comparison with the user, where the recording is taken from the professional user who has been stored in the database system. Furthermore, the second action is an action that comes from a novice user who performs the action in the current time and the result will be compared with the first action. The action data takes from X - Y coordinates value. The obtained the value of X and Y from the shoulder to the palm. The system proposes with our algorithm to show the assessment result of both actions comparison. It is displayed in the compatible percentages and the opposite one.

articleTitle: Time and Cost Optimization of Parallel Services on Line Balancing Problem Using Integer Programming
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Human resources are one of the most crucial assets of any enterprise. Optimal usage of manpower is a pivotal assignment to a manager of a dynamic control system. on this observe, we introduce a way of the concern constraints and the station limits for the parallel offerings on line Balancing problem. in lots of realistic settings, despite the fact that the real task time of a task is modeled as an growing characteristic of its starting time due to deterioration outcomes the produced man power develops constantly by means of repeated the equal or comparable activities. The technique aimed toward determining the effective size of manpower to be hired to make sure most earnings, contemplating, manufacturing or demand capacity and time of operation. This paper additionally discusses the edition of the Linear Integer Programming approach to make sure maximum earnings, deliberating, production or call for capacity and time of operation.

articleTitle: Bayesian Network Optimization for Earthquake Prediction Using Simulated Annealing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Earthquakes are natural disaster that can be very harmful. In case of earthquake, the data are recorded by the seismograph station. With the data, it will be carried out the prediction process using Bayesian Network, to obtain a technique which has the best accuracy in the earthquake prediction. This study compare the performance prediction between Bayesian Network alone with Bayesian Network which is optimized using simulated annealing. From the results of research conducted is proven that Simulated Annealing can improve the accuracy of earthquake prediction on BMKG online data by increasing 2.23% of accuracy.

articleTitle: Improving The Accuracy of Naïve Bayes Algorithm for Hoax Classification Using Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Hoax news circulation is very widespread which occurs in the media information, both print and online media. For some people hoax news can only appear on the online media. But printed medias also often include hoax news in their published news. In the present era, it is very important providing information with relevant and additional facts otherwise it is categorized as hoax. Therefore, hoax classification approach is needed. This paper focuses on improving the accuracy of hoax classification in textual documents contents. Naive Bayes algorithm is used to train dataset with the use of PSO in the algorithm. Experiment is conducted with the trained model over 600 documents. It shows that feature selection with PSO affects the classification results performed using Naïve Bayes. Accuracy increased from 91.17% without using feature selection, to 92.33% when feature selection is carried out using PSO.

articleTitle: Control System Scheme for Shuttlecock Thrower Robotic Based on PID-CSA
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: The robot manipulator ability in maintaining its acceleration is very important due to its duties for having physical task such as moving the object and throwing the object. However the disturbance from the external system can be influenced to the accuracy which can reduce the robotic performance. Therefore the accuracy in doing the task should be constantly stable. Adding control mechanishm for keeping its acceleration is the solution for improving the robotic performance. In this paper, we propose control system for shuttlecock thrower robotic which is adopted for ABU ROBOCON 2018 themes. This control system is used for maintaining the acceleration and the elevationin throwing process can reach the specified target. Mechanical modification as well as the weight of object being thrown is also can be affected to the system. The proposed system is using Proportional, Integral and Derivative (PID) based on cuckoo search algorithm (CSA). The function of PID control is keeping the acceleration constantly in specified elevation. While the CSA can simplify the tunning PID control when it has some parameter modification. The result of this paper is robust control system from the disturbance which is applied in shuttlecock thrower robotic based its manipulation.

articleTitle: Signal Measurement Consistency of ECVT Data Acquisition System Using Capacitor Array
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: This research relates to tomography based on capacitance measurement namely Electrical Capacitance Volume Tomography (ECVT). The paper discusses the design of ECVT data acquisition system that has frequent problems in measurement, such as error in signal measurement and fabrication errors. Based on those issue, development of an equipment that can help check the data acquisition system by using dummy capacitor array is proposed. In signal measurement, there are two modes: first without using array capacitor and second using capacitor array. By using a simple algorithm that refers to the measurement strategy, it is possible to immediately know which channel pair is experiencing problem. Measurement consistency on each channel is analyzed using the correlation coefficient (R) resulting an average value of 0.9387.

articleTitle: Analysis of 4G Network and Chat Applications to Smartphone Battery Life
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: This research aims to prove about the public perception of spendthrift of a smartphone battery life. Many people assume that their smartphone include wasteful with certain types of the use. In this study, the testing subject is the use of smartphones with a standard battery capacity ranging from 1500-2000 mAh, as well as the parameters of chat applications. Determination of the subject is done by establishing the list of event variables, which consists of 216 events contained in these parameters. The data was collected by doing observation directly in the field. Then, the collected data was processed and analyzed statistically by using the classification method with C4.5 algorithm. We also compared the results of manual calculations with WEKA tool and a simple application to test and evaluate the performance of the algorithm. The results showed that, the performance on manual calculation and simple application simulation generated a maximum accuracy of 100%. While, the WEKA get 93.06% accuracy value and experience a little error because there are some additional conditions performed on the calculation on the WEKA. This research contributes real to the science and add insight to the public that will have a true perception about the battery life of the smartphone.

articleTitle: Autonomous Controller for MetOcean Monitoring Station
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Marine environment is an important part of coastal community life. The environmental changes that occurred along with the development of activity and infrastructure development. It is necessary to conduct environmental monitoring by making autonomous controller for MetOcean monitoring station based on single board computer with AWS as meteorology sensor and ADCP sensor. The system works in gathering data from AWS and ADCP sensor. ADCP and AWS will be serialized to text data and transmitted to server through gsm modem. The output is observed weather parameters include temperature, pressure, humidity, speed, wind direction, solar radiation, and rainfall. While the physical parameters of the ocean waters are tidal, speed, direction of surface currents, surface temperature, salinity, wave height period. For the first time, this system was installed and tested in a port area.

articleTitle: Classification of Governer's Public Report from SMS LaporGub Using Naive Bayes Classifier Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Freedom to express people's feeling like complaint is one effort from a governor to improve a public service in Central Java Province. By knowing all complaints from people and sometimes they give some suggestions, it able to make better performance government in various aspects such as infrastructure, criminal, healthy, etc. To execute this effort, government establish a “SMS LaporGub” service which able to become an interaction and a communication media that hold all complaints that occur in public. It is already execute well and increase some performance in many aspects. The existence of a wide variety of complaints and high number of reports makes manual analysis becomes ineffective. It needed an automatic classification to classify and analyse the report based on its types. So administrator easy to handle those reports, prevent delay handling for urgent reports to be discussed. This study using classification method especially Naïve Bayes Classifier method.

articleTitle: Mobile Health Nutrition Book Design to Prevent Stunting at Childreen <5 Years
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Through the national health work meeting, stunting is one of three health problems that are prioritized to be handled holistically by several ministries. However, the treatment are preventive and curative from one party only (the government). Laymen, often do not understand things related to stunting itself. Stunting is a growth disorder that affects children's growth and development. Efforts can be made to support the program by providing health education for mothers. In the digital era, almost everyone has a smartphone that can be used for health education media. This study aims to compile a mobile book design that is expected to help mothers to monitor children's growth and development. The approach used in this study is an object-oriented approach. The method used is the method of developing SDLC prototyping models with usability testing. The steps taken are Requirement Analysis, Design & Development, and Application and Testing. Based on the results obtained, the mobile health nutrition book can be produced and used on mobile phones that have an Android form plate.

articleTitle: Reverse Polarity Scanning Method on 64-Channel Capacitive Sensor to Improve the Performance of ECVT System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: This research proposes a scanning method on tomography namely electrical capacitance volume tomography (ECVT). This study discusses the new scanning method of reverse polarity scanning that is applied to 64-channel capacitive sensors. In tomography process, the data acquisition system measures the capacitance from capacitive sensors using scanning process by activating the electrode pairs. Generally, scanning process in ECVT uses conventional scanning by activating an electrode pair and measure the capacitance signal for the pair. This study proposes a new scanning process, by reversing the polarity of electrode in scanning method. The method is applied by changing the polarity of excitation electrode into detection electrode, and vice versa. Then, both of methods are compared to evaluate the performance of the acquisition system. Simulation and experiment are performed using 64-channel capacitive sensors with cylinder rods phantom filled with water. To evaluate the performance of the ECVT system, static objects were used to measure parameters such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Coefficient-Correlation (R), and image qualitative observation. From the simulation and experiment, the Coefficient-Correlation (R) value as 0.6 and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) value as 0.2, so that the proposed method can improve image quality of 3.2%.

articleTitle: Evaluation Forecasting Method of Farmers Terms of Trade Indonesian Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: The agricultural sector is still the most highly employed sector. One indicator that can be used to measure success in the agricultural sector is Farmers Terms of Trade that is usually called Nilai Tukar Petani (NTP) in Indonesia. NTP is an indicator that can be used to measure purchasing power of farmers. NTP data is currently released at the beginning of every month based on the previous month's data condition. If NTP data can be predicted earlier, the government can take the right policy in advance. Some methods were used for forecasting data. In this research, we proposed NN, SVM and Multiple Linear Regression methods to forecast NTP. We conclude that Multiple Linear Regression is the best method to forecast NTP with RMSE 0.0009.

articleTitle: Speed Identification as Vehicle Safety Feature Based Eulerian Color Magnification
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Road accident which is caused vehicle collision is still big problem in Indonesia. Beside that, research of smart vehicle is still limit because not many supports to do it. Based on these two problems, the development of smart vehicle which exploits camera as collision detection to avoid accident is quite challenging. Speed identification may be a one of collision detection feature. Objective of this paper is to implement color magnification to vehicle object in video to improve speed identification result which is useful for safety feature in smart vehicle development. However, acquiring of speed data accuracy is still a challenging in researchers. Implementation of color magnification to vehicle objects that are captured by smart vehicle camera is an interesting concept that needs to be performed. Although there comes some different speed value that resulted from color magnification and non-color magnification implementation, it still be a compromise technique to achieve better result with some improvements in the next activity.

articleTitle: The Performance of FOSMC and Boundary - SMC in Speed Controller and Current Regulator for IFOC-Based Induction Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Indirect Field-Oriented Control (IFOC) is the part of vector control method which is suitable for industrial application especially for induction motor (IM) drives. It causes IFOC doesn't need flux sensor which changes the construction of 1M like Direct Field-Oriented Control (DFOC). Unfortunately, the robustness and the stability of the system cannot be guaranteed by IFOC. Sliding Mode Control (SMC) is a controller which can guarantee both of them. Ordinary SMC or First-Order SMC (FOSMC) has disadvantages in chattering phenomenon because of discontinuous control input (sign(.) function). This chattering phenomenon also consumes more power to a standstill the robustness. Chattering phenomenon can be reduced by giving thin boundary layer (Boundary - SMC). Boundary - SMC using saturation function proposed to reduced chattering phenomenon and power consumption. This paper discusses FOSMC and Boundary - SMC applied for speed controller (SC) and direct-current regulator in 10HP 1M. The results show power consumption using Boundary - SMC is lower than FOSMC (real power decreases 21.26<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, active power decreases 44.27% and apparent power decreases 25.49<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). Power factor analyze shows FOSMC in direct-current regulator is the best but consume more real power than the others.

articleTitle: Dinus Intelligent Assistance (DINA) Chatbot for University Admission Services
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Nowadays, universities offer most of their services using corporate website. In higher education services including admission services, a university needs to always provide excellent service to ensure student candidate satisfaction. To obtain student candidate satisfaction apart from the quality of education must also be accompanied by providing consultation services and information to them. This paper proposes the development of Chatbot which acts as a conversation agent that can play a role of as student candidate service. This Chatbot is called Dinus Intelligent Assistance (DINA). DINA uses knowledge based as a center for machine learning approach. The pattern extracted from the knowledge based can be used to provide responses to the user. The source of knowledge based is taken from Universitas Dian Nuswantoro (UDINUS) guest book. It contains of questions and answers about UDINUS admission services. Testing of this system is done by entering questions. From 166 intents, the author tested it using ten random sample questions. Among them, it got eight tested questions answered correctly. Therefore, by using this study we can develop further intelligent Chatbots to help student candidates find the information they need without waiting for the admission staffs's answer.

articleTitle: Vendor Track Record Selection Using Best Worst Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Every company will largely depend on other companies. This will help unite a large business process. Risks that arise from other companies will affect the business performance of a company. Because of this, the right choice for suppliers is crucial. Each vendor has different characteristics. Everything is not always suitable basically the selection process is quite complex and risky. This has led to a new case study which has been studied for years by researchers known as Supplier Selection Problems. Selection of vendors with multi-criteria decision making has been widely studied over years ago. The Best Worst Method is a new science in Multi-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) determination. In this research, taking case study at XYZ company is in Indonesia which is engaged in mining and industry. The research utilized the transaction data that have been recorded by the XYZ company and analyzed vendor valuation. The weighting of Best Worst Method is calculated based on vendor assessment result. The results show that XYZ company still focuses on Price as its key criteria.

articleTitle: Survey on Pedestrian-Dynamics Models for Evacuation Process Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: In this paper, we explore the application of game theory to model human decisions making and pedestrian dynamics for evacuation process. In game-theory approach, a pedestrian is represented as a player or an agent where the agent makes its decision by inspecting its neighbors' decision. The game theory is used to study behavioral relations and applied in the science of human behavior decisions. In pedestrian dynamics, the theory deals with individual interaction toward the destination considering psychology and physics. The matrix associated with game theory changes depending on distance to the evacuation exits and obstacles faced on the path, density of evacuees and so on. In this paper, we review the recent articles which studied the game theory to study the pedestrian dynamics and the evacuation process.

articleTitle: A Lexicon-Based Sentiment Analysis for Amazon Web Review
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: The development of internet more quickly over time as well as the development of e-commerce one of them is amazon.com. The amazon.com is one of the largest e-commerce in the world by providing various needs that can be accessed by internet. Review feature provided to make amazon.com party can know the various responses from consumers. However amazon.com difficulties in summarizing the various kinds of reviews that are positive or negative. By using one natural language processing the main purpose is to help the amazon.com in knowing the most responses from consumers to improve the quality service. In this research we will be using the dataset that was obtained from UCI Machine Learning that contain 1000 set of data which has 478 of negative data and 522 positive data and this will be combine a variety of classification methods for comparison and in preprocessing process will be added with lexicon technique to improve the quality of preprocessing. The result of this research is K-Nearest Neighbor with lexicon technique get highest accuracy with value 92.67% followed by SVM with lexicon get 91.33% accuracy and last Decision tree with 82% accuracy.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Data Mining Techniques for Suicide Attempt Characteristics Mapping and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: According to the report by Khon Kaen Rajanagarin-dra Psychiatric hospital, there are many factors such as poverty, loss, disappointment, alcohol addiction, addiction, chronic physical illness, depression, economic problems and major life changes that cause suicide attempts. However, there are some unsuccessful suicides. These individuals might try to repeatedly commit suicide attempts. In this paper, the aims of this research are to compare ID3, C4.5 and naïve Bayes and predict the characteristics of individuals who have suicidal ideation to repeatedly commit suicide attempts by using data mining techniques. After data preprocessing, three data mining techniques were selected to compare the efficiency of the single of classification models and the ensemble models. The researchers also adopted synthetic minority over-sampling technique (SMOTE) to balance the suicidal ideation of reattempt and no attempt classes. The researchers used 57 attributes from self-harm surveillance report (RP.506S) of Khon Kaen Rajanagarindra Psychiatric hospital. The experimental results of the single method showed that C4.5 is the best model with the highest percentage of correctly classified instances rate of 90.69%, while the ensemble model, voting method showed the best results of 91.26. We found the number of characteristics from C4.5 is 474 patterns. There are people, who have suicidal ideation over 500 in each case is 42 patterns. In 42 patterns, there are 22 patterns that more than 90% accuracy.

articleTitle: Heart Rate Monitoring System in Virtual Environment: The Case of Daily Exercise with Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: The emergence of impressive virtual reality (VR) devices make the virtual reality applications are very popular. There are several VR applications which is involve the user's physical activity while making any interaction with virtual entities. Sometimes the user is not aware that physical activity can drain a lot of energy. The effect of the user who lacks energy is user feel exhausted. One indicator of exhausted is heart rate changes. Current wearable devices have a lot of attached sensor. We proposed the model to monitor users heart rate while making any physical activities in the virtual environment by using the wearable device. Machine to Machine (M2M) communication through an internet network (wireless) can be used to integrate the VR system and wearable device system. In this case, user simulate daily exercise through VR application to make any physical activities. Users felt that this heart rate monitoring system was satisfied, effective, and efficient measured by an adapted System Usability Scale (SUS) questionnaire.

articleTitle: Improving Classifier Performance Using Particle Swarm Optimization on Heart Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Data mining is an evolving technology that aims to extract information from very large data to generate useful knowledge. Lots of datasets provided online can be beneficial in the context of research, such as medical datasets obtained from public and private repository developed to conduct a clinical diagnosis of diseases. Hence, we employ a public dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository on heart disease. in the current study, we proposed an improvement of the classifier, i.e. Naive Bayes, Decision tree, and k-Nearest Neighbor on detection of heart disease using the particle swarm optimization. additionally, the proposed approach runs to select some significant features as data entries for the classification phase in order to improve the performance of the classifiers. the Experimental results show that our built-model in selecting prime features increases the performance accuracy of heart disease detection. eventually, The main objective, as well as advantage of this study, are to provide a significant improvement of classifiers' performance, which then resulted in the correct diagnosis on time.

articleTitle: Improving Information Service Performance of Family Businesses Through IT Governance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: data mining; pattern classification; Internet; feature extraction; business data processing; Bayes methods; learning (artificial intelligence); sentiment analysis; mobile computing; text analysis.

articleTitle: Media Economics and the Use of Technology in the Production of Local Gaming Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: This research aims to reveal how the dynamics of the local game industry, especially in Yogyakarta. To be able to survive in the market and compete with foreign game products, the local game developers must also be able to adapt to the latest technology, to produce the games that the consumers want and have unique characteristics, because the game is one of the media industries that also has and uses limited resources to produce entertainment contents in digital forms that is distributed to the consumers to satisfy their needs. This research tries to examine the structure of the local game market players, and how the production process carried out with the technology is used optimally. The results show that in Yogyakarta, this type of industry has increased along with the economic growth, and on the stage of production process, the game developers use the technology with the game engine whose output can be applied to a multiplatform called Unity.

articleTitle: Analysis of Potencies and Investment Opportunities in East Java Based on Geographic Information System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Seminar on Application for Technology of Information and Communication
abstract: Investment is one of indicators to economic growth and to this effort to ensure sustainable economic growth efforts need to be made investment have been dealt with. At the time there is no a system accurate provides the potential and investment opportunities in a region. So that related department experienced difficulty in attract investor to invest capital and realize investment. The system to be built is Web-based Geographic Information System which provides information on potential and investment opportunities in East Java. The system is combined with Gross Regional Domestic Potential data using Identified Sector Location Location Quotient (LQ) Identification Technique, Growth Ratio Model Analysis, Shift Share Analysis and Overlay Analysis using classifier modeling to know the indication of grouping of sub-regions in an area. In the Kediri district case study the potentials and opportunities of the fishery sector can be seen directly through the geographic information system application.
